# Poor accessibility on S-SFX-004 caused by a bad configuration change

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `AGG-SFX-01`
- **Confidence:** medium (Timing matches the configuration push CHG-2026-0071 at 01:36 and KPI onset at 01:30, with unaffected control sites and no maintenance.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-28 01:30 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-28 01:36
- **Affected:** S-SFX-001, S-SFX-004, S-SFX-005, S-SFX-007, AGG-SFX-01

## Summary

Push of RAN parameter template RT-2.4 (admission control and RRC timers) via CHG-2026-0071 degraded accessibility on S-SFX-004 and other dependent sites.

S-SFX-004 suffered poor accessibility and RRC failure rate increase starting 2026-09-28 01:30, ongoing.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-28 01:30: Earliest KPI deviation onset and alert ALR-0039 active for S-SFX-004 accessibility. [ALR-0039, T8]
- 2026-09-28 01:36: Config push CHG-2026-0071 executed on AGG-SFX-01 pushing parameter template RT-2.4. [CHG-2026-0071, T14]
- 2026-09-28 01:54: Minor alarm ALM-000616 raised for RRC failure rate high on S-SFX-004. [ALM-000616, T3]

## Evidence

- S-SFX-004 depends on fiber link LNK-SFX-01-B and aggregation router AGG-SFX-01. [T2]
- Deviation occurred in 8 of 8 series with earliest onset at 01:30. [T8]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-SFX-004, LNK-SFX-01-B, AGG-SFX-01 or its parents. [T5]
- CHG-2026-0071 was executed on AGG-SFX-01 at 01:36 pushing parameter template RT-2.4. [T14]
- Sites S-SFX-002 and S-SFX-003 showed no KPI deviations between 00:00 and 08:20. [T9]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at AGG-SFX-01: confirmed. Config push CHG-2026-0071 executed on AGG-SFX-01 matches the KPI degradation on connected sites starting at 01:30. [CHG-2026-0071, T14]
2. **planned_maintenance** at AGG-SFX-01: rejected. No maintenance window was scheduled on the affected nodes or their parents. [T5]

## Ruled out

- T5: No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected nodes or their parents during the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Roll back configuration change CHG-2026-0071 on AGG-SFX-01.
- Verify RRC success percentage KPIs recover after rollback.
- Escalate to RAN operations and change management.
